reviews.boundary_analysis: Scaffolding explicitly loads standards before files exist and private references only by task triggers. Fixed workflow routing, metadata/glob hierarchy, only-root OP/DEC imports, directed references/private-skill confinement, name-leak exceptions and complete MAP accounting all have specific independent records. Actual-state root fallback/snapshot behavior is registered in BF-0137/0142/0191 rather than treated as mandatory product code.
Substantial feature/new-app review must precede final verification and confirmed findings must be fixed. The added correction step beyond canonical review timing is already explicitly registered.

Verification completion is scope/risk based, plus specific settings synchronization and pre-PR invocation. Stop reminders use content fingerprints, bounded history and no-Git skip with address/explain response rather than unconditional successful completion. These trigger and reporting conditions are prior-covered.

Diff review occurs before choosing checks and again after all fixes. Final review includes stale probes/scripts, TODO/FIXME, temporary logging, drift and manually verified behavior lacking tests. Both timing and each listed target are recorded, not merely generic scope checking.

No --no-restore without known restore, declared frontend scripts, full small-solution suite versus risk-based larger scope and investigation before dismissing new failures are explicit. Scaffolding cannot be reported complete if it does not build; prior union retains that completion gate.

Swagger confirmation on any API behavior change exceeds broad startup trigger, already BF-0012. Fresh Development DB on schema/seeding changes and container image/startup/nonroot/probe validation are separately covered. Successful compilation does not substitute for actual runtime composition.

Reviewed actual checkers beyond generic risk-based checks: selected path sets/5000 limit, decode errors, textual XML attributes, named hooks and post-failure inspection, Conforms owner declaration, cycle errors and warning-only success are explicit baseline claims. Wrapper inline-only/depth/lexical cwd behavior is BF-0129/0130; in-root/missing-file behavior BF-0125. Existing iterative JSON/read-error findings and relative-path-prefix U0001 remain distinct and are not rediscovered. Detailed boundary probes remain family4 work, not completed by this canonical sweep.
